caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest with a rectangular shape, shown at an angle to reveal both the front and right side. The chest is rendered in shades of brown, indicating the natural color of the wood. The front panel features carved decorative elements, including four vertical sections each with an arch motif, with a vertical carved leaf pattern inside each arch, as well as central rosette-like flower carvings between the arches. The top edge and the side panels are plain, while the lower edge of the front features a band of carved overlapping foliage patterns. The chest sits on short, square legs and the perspective shows the thickness of the wood panels, emphasizing the three-dimensional form of the furniture. The drawing is outlined with a thin rectangular border, and there are no other objects or background elements present.
title: Chest
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
